sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the verb of the LORD's command, 'get up and ___ around the land.' Nothing on the earlier cards (card 9 only covers the dust promise) lets a baker reason to 'walk' over 'ride' or 'camp'. This tests the wording of a line, and the pick comes down to luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
